pledges_vs_reality.pledge: States and corporations pledge net zero; global energy CO2 was to fall.
pledges_vs_reality.reality: Energy-related CO2 rose ~145 Mt to a record ~38.4 Gt, 5% above 2019; gas +85 Mt drove growth.

pledges_vs_reality.pledge: Paris goal: limit warming to 1.5C via NDCs.
pledges_vs_reality.reality: Full NDC implementation => 2.3-2.5C; current policies => 2.8C. New NDCs barely moved the needle (0.1C method, 0.1C US exit). UNFCCC synthesis: +16% emissions by 2030 vs 2010.

pledges_vs_reality.pledge: Crack down on vague green claims.
pledges_vs_reality.reality: Directive (EU) 2024/825 applies from 27 Sep 2026; generic claims ('green','eco') banned without proven performance; fines up to 10% turnover.
pledges_vs_reality.metric: Effective 27 Sep 2026; up to 10% turnover fine

pledges_vs_reality.pledge: Close the ambition gap at COP30.
pledges_vs_reality.reality: 119 countries (74% emissions) submitted new NDCs; Global Mutirao + Belem Mission to 1.5 launched, but focus on implementation, not tighter binding targets. Adaptation finance goal tripled.

pledges_vs_reality.pledge: 24 major corporations claim credible net-zero / carbon-neutral paths.
pledges_vs_reality.reality: Plan only 36% real footprint cut by net-zero date; neutrality claims cover <2-3% of actual emissions (Microsoft, Apple, DHL <2%).
pledges_vs_reality.metric: 36% planned cut; <2-3% coverage of neutrality claims

highlights: IEA: global energy CO2 hit a record ~38.4 Gt in 2025, still rising despite net-zero pledges.
UNEP: full NDC implementation still leaves us at 2.3-2.5C; current policies 2.8C.
EU greenwashing ban (ECGT) takes effect 27 Sep 2026 with fines up to 10% turnover.
COP30 produced implementation tools but left the ambition gap open; 119 countries submitted NDCs.
Carbon Market Watch: 24 firms plan only 36% real cuts, hiding the rest behind offsets.
actions_taken: Researched IEA, UNEP, UNFCCC, EU ECGT, COP30, Carbon Market Watch via web
Opened PR against main (human review only)
